subject: Code-judge (single-attempt): review task #4 attempt before merge
description: Single-attempt code-review gate for the rework-aware cost-accumulation task (f1653e44.../4), per the dispatcher convention added in #3. Blocked_by #4 so it goes ready when #4's worker completes. When dispatched, the worker runs the self-learn-judge skill in SINGLE-ATTEMPT review mode against #4's attempt branch (orch/attempt/f1653e44-5863-4644-bebc-963582c76510-4): fetch the attempt diff and apply the code-review rubric (correctness, scope discipline incl. no stray out-of-scope files like the bench-economy 2-dot artifact we saw, dead/redundant code, test presence & quality, style), then APPROVE (hold-merge: record verdict, do NOT merge) or KICK BACK (set_status failed + wired record_decision with required fixes). NEVER force-merge. CAVEAT: the get_attempt_diff MCP tool + merge_attempt are NOT live until the pending daemon restart, so the judge fetches the diff via raw git (git diff main...<branch>) and runs in hold-merge/record mode only. Use three-dot (merge-base) diff to avoid the two-dot artifact.
